_readme: Symptom -> cause -> fix, keyed to metrics.py metric names (computed: retention, sends_per_1k_reach, saves_per_1k_reach, skip_rate_vs_median, avg_watch_time_s; raw: views, reach, likes, comments, saves, shares, skip_rate, profile_visits, follows; link_clicks when tracked; length is the post's length tag). Each row's `when` conditions must all hold (median = NUMA's own rolling median for that post type, strategy.py score). strategy.py diagnose lists the rows a post matches; the Strategist puts the fix and try_patterns into the next brief, and the Scriptwriter uses them on the next post of that series. Seeded from spec p.8-11 and research/1-content-benchmarks.md; R3 deep research adds rows through strategy.py import-research.

diagnosis.symptom: Skip rate more than 5 points above NUMA's median: people leave in the first 3 seconds.
diagnosis.cause: Frame zero didn't stop the scroll: no movement, no contrast, or the hook text wasn't readable at once.
diagnosis.fix: Open on a contrast or weather visual with full-opacity hook text from frame zero; cut the first shot to under 2 s.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Socialinsider 140K Reels: 65.5% average 3-second skip for 1K-5K accounts)
spec p.8, p.40
evidence.notes: The baseline is measured; the fix is the spec's rule and opinion.

diagnosis.symptom: A Trial Reel's skip rate is 5+ points above the Trial Reel median: non-followers don't recognise why it's for them.
diagnosis.cause: The hook assumes context only followers have (an in-joke, a name they don't know).
diagnosis.fix: Lead with the place or the question a stranger has; keep names for later in the reel.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Trial Reels go to non-followers first; compare trials only with trials)

diagnosis.symptom: The hook held (normal skip rate) but retention is 20%+ below NUMA's median: the middle sags.
diagnosis.cause: Shots run too long, there's no turn, or the script explains before it shows.
diagnosis.fix: No shot over 4 beats; put a turn near the middle; show the thing while saying it.

sources: config/studio.json critic rubric (retention and pacing)
spec p.18-19 (edit grammar)

diagnosis.symptom: Longer than 60 s and retention below NUMA's median.
diagnosis.cause: Past 60 s the measured views per Reel stop rising; the extra length cost watchers.
diagnosis.fix: Trim to 45-60 s; move detail into a carousel the next day.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Socialinsider 9.77M Reels: 45-60 s 10,374 median views, 60-90 s 9,790)
spec p.9

diagnosis.symptom: Under 30 s and views 20%+ below NUMA's reel median.
diagnosis.cause: Short clips get fewer views for brand accounts; fine for atmosphere, weak for discovery.
diagnosis.fix: Make the next growth reel in this series 45-60 s.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Socialinsider: 0-30 s 4,700 median views vs 10,374 at 45-60 s)

diagnosis.symptom: Sends per 1,000 reach 30%+ below NUMA's median: nobody had a reason to send it.
diagnosis.cause: The post is about NUMA, not about someone the viewer knows.
diagnosis.fix: Build the next one around a person to send it to (a plunge partner, a night-shift friend) and end on a share line.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Mosseri, Jan 2025: sends are a top ranking signal, slightly more for non-followers; official)
evidence.notes: Why sends matter is official; the fix is opinion.

diagnosis.symptom: Likes above NUMA's median but sends below it: pleasant, not useful or relatable.
diagnosis.cause: Followers enjoy it; it gives a stranger nothing to forward.
diagnosis.fix: Keep the look, add a specific use (a tip, a plan for two) and a share line.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (likes matter more for followers, sends for non-followers; official)

diagnosis.symptom: A carousel's saves per 1,000 reach 30%+ below NUMA's carousel median.
diagnosis.cause: Not worth coming back to: too promotional or too general.
diagnosis.fix: Make the next carousel a concrete protocol or comparison with a save line on the last slide.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Socialinsider: carousels earn the saves below 50K followers)
evidence.notes: The role of carousels is measured; the fix is opinion.

diagnosis.symptom: An education reel's saves are far below NUMA's median.
diagnosis.fix: End on one tip worth keeping and 'Save this for...'; pair it with Tuesday's carousel.

sources: spec p.34 (Tuesday carousel from Monday's topic)

diagnosis.symptom: Reach 30%+ below NUMA's median but the people it reached engaged well.
diagnosis.cause: Distribution, not content: posting time, or it never reached non-followers.
diagnosis.fix: Try a different hour band next time and test the hook as a Trial Reel; consider a collab post.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Metricool: about 65% of a Reel's views arrive in 3 days; no niche study shows a best hour)
evidence.notes: Timing evidence is a gap; the hour change is an experiment.

diagnosis.symptom: Views well above NUMA's median, follows not.
diagnosis.cause: The profile doesn't convert visitors: name field, bio or pinned reels don't say what NUMA is.
diagnosis.fix: Check the profile name field ('Sauna + Cold Plunge Mobile AL'), the bio CTA and the pinned offer reel; end reels with a soft local CTA.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (profile SEO: Instagram search indexes the name field)

diagnosis.symptom: Profile visits up, link clicks down.
diagnosis.cause: People looked but the next step wasn't clear.
diagnosis.fix: Say the offer and where the link is in the last line and the caption's first line.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (Book button and Discover NUMA link)

diagnosis.symptom: A sales post reached 40%+ fewer people than NUMA's median.
diagnosis.cause: It led with the price; sales-first posts give strangers no reason to watch.
diagnosis.fix: Experience first, offer in the last beat; keep it to one sales post a week.

sources: spec p.34 rule 1 (at most one sales-focused reel a week)

diagnosis.symptom: A carousel reached fewer people than usual but saves are healthy.
diagnosis.cause: Expected for an account under 50K: Reels lead on reach, carousels on saves.
diagnosis.fix: No change; judge carousels on saves, use reels for discovery.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Socialinsider reach rate by size: Reels lead below 50K followers)

diagnosis.symptom: A single image reached fewer people than NUMA's image median.
diagnosis.cause: Single images reach least of all feed formats.
diagnosis.fix: Keep images for announcements and followers; put discovery topics in a reel.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Metricool 2026: Reels reach 212% more people than single images)

diagnosis.symptom: Comments less than half NUMA's median.
diagnosis.fix: End community posts on a simple question people can answer in one word.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (event and community posts drive comments, inference)

diagnosis.symptom: Good hook, but average watch time 25%+ below NUMA's median.
diagnosis.cause: The explanation is too slow after the hook.
diagnosis.fix: Kinetic text with one idea per beat, 2.3 words a second, cut any line that repeats the hook.

sources: config/studio.json render.words_per_second
research/1-content-benchmarks.md (watch time is a top signal; official)
